name: Parse scene msg
text:
import gzip

import numpy as np
import yt.wrapper as yt
from scene_gt_pb2 import Scene
from sdg.sdc.library.python.yt_processing.yt_msgs import deserialization

client = yt.YtClient(proxy="kolmogorov")

table = yt.TablePath(
    name="{cursor}",
    start_index=0,
)
for row in client.read_table(table):
    break
    
msg = deserialization.deserialize(row)
bytes_ = np.array(msg.features).tobytes()
scene = Scene()
scene.ParseFromString(gzip.decompress(bytes_))

name: Parse scene proto
text:
import gzip

import yt.wrapper as yt
from scene_gt_pb2 import Scene

client = yt.YtClient(proxy="kolmogorov")
table = yt.TablePath(
    name="{cursor}",
    start_index=0,
)

for row in client.read_table(table):
    break

bytes_ = yt.yson.get_bytes(row["scene"])
scene = Scene()
scene.ParseFromString(gzip.decompress(bytes_))

name: Parse scene tensors
text:
import onnx
import yt.wrapper as yt


def parse_tensors(scene_tensors: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out = {}
    for x in scene_tensors:
        tensor = onnx.helper.TensorProto()
        tensor.ParseFromString(yt.yson.get_bytes(x["value"]))
        out[x["key"]] = onnx.numpy_helper.to_array(tensor)
    return out


client = yt.YtClient(proxy="kolmogorov")

table = yt.TablePath(
    name="{cursor}",
    start_index=0,
)

for row in client.read_table(table):
    break

tensors = parse_tensors(row["scene_tensors"])
